system.name: Employee Onboarding System
system.purpose: Ensure every new hire is productive, compliant, equipped, and connected by Day 1.

desired_outcomes.text: New hires can perform core work on Day 1
Payroll and access are correct before start date

constraints.text: Manager input is required before provisioning can complete

process_steps.name: Create onboarding case
process_steps.purpose: Create one traceable onboarding instance and establish authoritative employee/start-date data.
process_steps.trigger: candidate becomes hired / employment is approved
process_steps.action: create onboarding case with unique case ID and initial readiness status
process_steps.decision_rule: reject duplicate active onboarding case for the same employment record
process_steps.control: employment record must be approved and source-of-truth ID must be present
process_steps.completion_evidence: case ID and creation timestamp recorded
process_steps.recovery: correct source record and retry idempotently
process_steps.escalation: People Ops lead for duplicate/conflicting source records
process_steps.verification: integration test creates exactly one case per employment record
process_steps.validation: all approved hires enter onboarding without manual discovery

process_steps.name: Collect manager requirements
process_steps.purpose: Capture the role-specific information required by downstream teams before provisioning begins.
process_steps.decision_rule: all mandatory fields and controlled access selections must be complete
process_steps.control: restricted access requests must use approved catalogue/justification
process_steps.recovery: remind, escalate, or route unsupported request for review
process_steps.escalation: manager's manager at T-7 if missing
process_steps.validation: downstream teams receive enough information to fulfill the actual role need without rework

process_steps.name: Validate manager input
process_steps.purpose: Prevent invalid or incomplete requirements from reaching provisioning systems.
process_steps.action: validate completeness, eligibility and known catalog mappings
process_steps.decision_rule: if mandatory data or eligibility rule fails, do not provision; route exception
process_steps.completion_evidence: validation result recorded with rule version
process_steps.audit_evidence: validation decision + rule version + inputs hash/reference
process_steps.verification: unit/integration tests cover every deterministic rule
process_steps.validation: invalid requests are prevented without delaying valid hires unnecessarily

process_steps.name: Provision identity and core access
process_steps.purpose: Provide the employee with the minimum approved digital identity and access needed to work.
process_steps.action: create identity account and assign approved baseline access
process_steps.decision_rule: grant only access authorized by validated profile; privileged access follows separate approval
process_steps.completion_evidence: successful identity/access API responses reconciled to expected assignments
process_steps.recovery: bounded retry/reconciliation; manual identity review for duplicates
process_steps.escalation: IT service owner if unresolved at T-2
process_steps.verification: integration test verifies exact expected entitlements
process_steps.validation: new hire can authenticate and access core work tools on Day 1

process_steps.name: Allocate and prepare device
process_steps.purpose: Ensure the employee has a suitable ready-to-use device before start.
process_steps.action: reserve/order, configure and assign device to employee
process_steps.decision_rule: use standard profile unless approved exception exists
process_steps.control: asset assignment must match employee and approved profile
process_steps.completion_evidence: asset ID + configuration status + delivery/collection confirmation
process_steps.recovery: allocate approved fallback device or expedited supplier route
process_steps.escalation: IT asset owner if no viable device by T-2
process_steps.verification: asset inventory and employee assignment reconcile
process_steps.validation: employee receives a functioning device before or at start

process_steps.name: Create payroll record
process_steps.purpose: Ensure the employee is correctly configured for first payroll.
process_steps.action: create or update payroll employee record and confirm inclusion in correct payroll cycle
process_steps.decision_rule: do not infer compensation or statutory attributes; use authoritative records only
process_steps.sla: before applicable payroll cutoff and no later than T-3 where feasible
process_steps.completion_evidence: payroll record reconciles to approved employment data
process_steps.recovery: collect missing data/retry/reconcile; off-cycle process only under approved policy
process_steps.validation: employee receives correct first pay on the intended cycle

process_steps.name: Run pre-start readiness gate
process_steps.purpose: Detect unresolved blockers early enough to recover before Day 1.
process_steps.trigger: T-3 checkpoint or all critical provisioning tasks report complete
process_steps.action: evaluate each critical readiness dimension and assign GREEN / AT_RISK / BLOCKED
process_steps.decision_rule: GREEN only when every critical readiness dimension has success evidence
process_steps.sla: T-3 and again T-1 for previously at-risk cases
process_steps.control: no self-reported completion without evidence for critical items
process_steps.completion_evidence: timestamped readiness evaluation with source evidence
process_steps.recovery: route each blocker to accountable owner and invoke bounded recovery catalogue
process_steps.escalation: People Ops lead if any critical blocker remains at T-1
process_steps.verification: synthetic cases confirm correct status for all combinations
process_steps.validation: readiness status predicts actual Day-1 ability to work

process_steps.name: Recover at-risk onboarding
process_steps.purpose: Restore acceptable readiness without silently changing policy or authority.
process_steps.trigger: readiness gate returns AT_RISK or BLOCKED
preconditions: approved recovery action exists or human owner assigned
process_steps.action: apply bounded recovery action, route/escalate unresolved blocker and re-evaluate readiness
process_steps.decision_rule: automatic action allowed only if pre-approved, reversible/low-risk and within single-case blast radius
process_steps.sla: immediate routing; critical blocker response within 4 business hours
process_steps.completion_evidence: recovery action and post-action readiness result recorded
process_steps.recovery: human-led containment or redesign as appropriate
process_steps.audit_evidence: trigger, diagnosis, authority, action, before/after state
process_steps.verification: recovery scenario tests stay within defined authority
process_steps.validation: recovery prevents employee-impacting Day-1 failure without creating unsafe exceptions

process_steps.name: Validate Day-1 outcome
process_steps.purpose: Confirm that operational completion resulted in actual employee productivity rather than checklist success only.
process_steps.action: confirm employee can perform defined core Day-1 tasks and record unresolved friction
process_steps.decision_rule: operational checklist completion does not equal validation success
process_steps.sla: by end of first working day
process_steps.control: collect minimum necessary employee feedback and avoid sensitive free-text where not required
process_steps.recovery: restore access/equipment or route functional issue to owner
process_steps.escalation: People Ops if productivity blocker remains unresolved
process_steps.verification: validation task is generated for every started hire
process_steps.validation: target outcome >=98% of hires can perform agreed core Day-1 tasks

risks.name: Late manager data blocks laptop setup
risks.recovery: route to exception queue and escalate

fitness_checks.requirement: Every hire should be ready for core work on Day 1
fitness_checks.mechanism: readiness check across access, equipment, payroll and manager plan
fitness_checks.pass_condition: all critical readiness items green before start
fitness_checks.validation: new hire confirms ability to perform core tasks during first workday

recovery_actions.action: route to exception lane, notify manager, and assign backup follow-up owner
recovery_actions.verification: critical Day-1 dependencies return to green
recovery_actions.escalation: People Ops lead if still blocked at T-3

transitions.change: introduce T-10 readiness check and late-input exception lane
transitions.rollback: retain current workflow while disabling new exception-routing automation
